description_en: Configures auto-renewal for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
description_zh: 设置MongoDB实例的自动续费功能
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-instance-auto-renewal-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id 'dds-bp15da1923e3****' --auto-renew true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceAutoRenewalAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html进行查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal duration. Unit: months.

Valid values: 1 to 12.

This parameter is available and required only when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费时长，单位：月。

取值范围：1~12（整数）。

当AutoRenew参数传入的值为true时，本参数才可用，且必须传入
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal.

When this parameter is set to true, you must also specify the Duration parameter
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值说明：
true：开启自动续费。
false：不开启自动续费。

当本参数取值为true时，您还需要传入Duration参数
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符，且该参数值中不能包含非 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without calling the operation. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and available resources. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次请求执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查，不真正调用该接口。检查项包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接执行本次操作
parameters.name: dry_run
